div.div: أَطْرَطُ الحَاجِبَيْنِ A man destitute of eyebrows; (AZ, S, O;) as also أَمْرَطُ الحلجبين; (O;) and some say أَضْرَطُ, but Abu-l-Ghowth knew it not: (S, O:) or having light, thin, or scanty, hair of the eyebrows; and so الحَاجِبِيْنِ ↓ طَرِطُ : (K:) the mention of the حَاجِبَانِ is indispensable; (AZ, S, O, K;) but sometimes omitted, on the ground of a weak authority: (K, TA:) and accord. to Ibn-'Abbád, أَطْرَطُ signifies having thin eyebrows. (O.) And طَرْطَآءُ العَيْنِ A woman having scanty eyelashes. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
